text: The Earthquake Safety Project for Rural Dwellings (ESPRD) is a national initiative in China aimed at enhancing the seismic safety of rural, self-built housing. It focuses on reducing the vulnerability of these structures by promoting earthquake-resistant designs and retrofitting existing buildings. The program provides financial subsidies to rural households, disseminates standardized earthquake-resistant designs, and offers training for local construction artisans. It operates through a central-local government coordination model, allowing for adaptation to local conditions across various provinces.
